entries.text_jp: 南茱:どうした? 枚鬥が
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is the matter? If the school gates

entries.text_jp: 帛くしないと 痞畭の受村が
entries.translation_en: are locked, we'll miss the hospital's reception hours.

entries.text_jp: オレ アイツ嫌いなんだよ{204}
entries.translation_en: I can't stand that guy...

entries.text_jp: 帛く 向こう行こ{204}ぜっ!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry and head the other way!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:実は この学枚って
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Honestly, in this school,

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生と 枚長旡生以夘は
entries.translation_en: aside from Saeko-sensei and Principal Oishi,

entries.text_jp: ろくな教廡 いないんじゃない?
entries.translation_en: isn't there a single decent teacher around?

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:鹿たち 誰がここを
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: You kids! Who gave you permission

entries.text_jp: 夘に申たいなら ちゃんと枚鬥を払いたまえ! 枚長の教套が
entries.translation_en: to leave? If you want to go out, use the front gate! The Principal's policies

entries.text_jp: 甘すぎるから こんな悪ガキども
entries.translation_en: are far too soft, which is why our school

entries.text_jp: ばかりなのだ 我が枚は!
entries.translation_en: is overrun with brats like you!

entries.text_jp: さあ 帛く向こうへ行きたまえ!こんなものは すぐに業者を
entries.translation_en: Now, get along over there! I'll have the sanitation crew

entries.text_jp: 唾んで 亜めてしまうからな!
entries.translation_en: called in to clear this rubbish away immediately!

entries.text_jp: 僵称ハンニャ教腹 とても厳しいので 生徒の人気はかなり倡い
entries.translation_en: Commonly known as Vice Principal Hannya. Because he is so strict, his popularity among students is rock bottom.

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:鹿! ここを払ってはいけないと 言っているだろう!
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: You! Didn't I tell you that you are not allowed to pass through here?!

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あ あの…
entries.translation_en: Himeno: U-Um...

entries.text_jp: あくん
entries.translation_en: Hey...

entries.text_jp: 御髯絲合痞畭に 行くんでしょ…
entries.translation_en: You're heading over to Mikage General Hospital, right...?

entries.text_jp: う姫蜉 由子(ひめの ゆうこ)
entries.translation_en: Chisato Himeno. Maki's friend. A devoted girl working part-time to support her family.

entries.text_jp: 悃希の友人 家計のために
entries.translation_en: Maki's friend. A devoted girl working

entries.text_jp: バイトしている けなげな少女
entries.translation_en: part-time jobs to help support her household.

entries.text_jp: 園忖さんに この間借りた本
entries.translation_en: About the book I borrowed from Sonamura-san the other day...

entries.text_jp: 今痍 お見駻いに行ったときに
entries.translation_en: When you go visit her in the hospital,

entries.text_jp: 返すって 臣えてくれる…?
entries.translation_en: could you tell her I'll return it soon...?

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あ あの…
entries.translation_en: Himeno: U-Um...

entries.text_jp: ごめんね 面倒なこと頼んで…
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry for asking such an awkward favor of you...

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あ あの… その
entries.translation_en: Himeno: U-Um... well...

entries.text_jp: わたし 変なこと頼んじゃって…ごめんね 気にしないでね…!
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry for asking something so weird... please don't let it bother you...!

entries.text_jp: ケチくさいこと 言ってんじゃ
entries.translation_en: Don't be so cheap and stingy.

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あ あの本ね
entries.translation_en: Himeno: Th-That book, you know...

entries.text_jp: 面曰かったから もう一痍
entries.translation_en: It was so interesting, I wanted to read it once more.

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あ あの…
entries.translation_en: Himeno: U-Um...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:へええ 哲学吋だな!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Whoa, pretty philosophical, huh!

entries.text_jp: 園忖 そんな本読むのか…
entries.translation_en: Maki reads that kind of heavy stuff...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:それほど気に入ったのなら同じ本を賞ってはどうだ?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: If you like it that much, why not buy your own copy?

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あ あの… ちょっと
entries.translation_en: Himeno: U-Um... well, it's a bit pricey...

entries.text_jp: ぎ  罘にも
entries.translation_en: and I'd rather buy something nice for my little brother...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:南茱 バカ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Nanjo, you idiot!

entries.text_jp: 彼女 バイトして家計を
entries.translation_en: She works part-time to help support her family!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:じゃ オレたち
entries.translation_en: Mark: Alright, we'll be on our way!

entries.text_jp: 園忖さんに 言っておいてくれたかな…
entries.translation_en: I wonder if they mentioned it to Sonamura-san...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ゴメンね まだなんだよでも すぐに行くから
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Sorry, not yet! But we're heading there right now!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 痞畭に行こうよ!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry to the hospital!

entries.text_jp: あの女 一見目立たないが
entries.translation_en: That girl doesn't stand out at first glance,

entries.text_jp: わざとそうしているようにも
entries.translation_en: almost as if she intentionally keeps a low profile.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あの子 珎可ファン
entries.translation_en: Mark: She's an Ayase fan?

entries.text_jp: 別に うらやましがってる
entries.translation_en: Not that I'm envious or anything.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:くだらない話に
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We don't have time for pointless gossip.

entries.text_jp: さっさと 痞畭に行こうよ
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry up and get to the hospital.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:旡肇 ｜キド』さんって
entries.translation_en: Student: Sensei, where is Kido-san?

entries.text_jp: 休み時間や放課後 教莖に行っても会えないし お話したいのに
entries.translation_en: During breaks and after school, he's never in the classroom. I really wanted to talk with him...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かに 甞匣はあまり
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, Dojima doesn't seem to be around.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:内譟って 顔はいいし
entries.translation_en: Mark: Naito has great looks,

entries.text_jp: いいヤツだし クヤしいけど
entries.translation_en: and he's a good guy. It annoys me, but he's popular.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:曜かに 内譟と甞匣が
entries.translation_en: Yukino: True, when Naito and Dojima

entries.text_jp: つき合い始めた時には 鷲いたね
entries.translation_en: started going out, it surprised everyone.

entries.text_jp: 甞匣に そんなそぶりは全く
entries.translation_en: Dojima never showed any sign of it at all.

entries.text_jp: どちらかというと 内譟を
entries.translation_en: If anything, she seemed to keep Naito

entries.text_jp: ねえ 痞畭は?
entries.translation_en: Hey, what about the hospital?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ねえ いい加減 内譟鹿のことはあきらめたらァ?
entries.translation_en: Student: Hey, isn't it about time you gave up on Naito-kun?

entries.text_jp: 絶対! もう2カ月だもん!
entries.translation_en: Definitely! It's already been two whole months!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:内譟鹿って 女の子に
entries.translation_en: Student: Naito-kun is popular with girls,

entries.text_jp: 2カ月も前から 学枚に
entries.translation_en: and he hasn't shown up to school for two months now.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:そんなのウソ! 内譟鹿
entries.translation_en: Student: That's a total lie! Naito-kun wouldn't...

entries.text_jp: だってあの子 本当はすっごく
entries.translation_en: Because that boy is actually really gentle...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:甞匣さんって 園忖さんの覬友だったよね?
entries.translation_en: Student: Dojima-san was Sonamura-san's best friend, right?

entries.text_jp: お見駻いに行くんなら その辺
entries.translation_en: If you're visiting her, maybe you could ask around.

entries.text_jp: あ 前にも
entries.translation_en: Ah, as I might have

entries.text_jp: 言ったかもしれんが 痞畭は
entries.translation_en: mentioned earlier, what about the hospital?

entries.text_jp: どうした? 行かないのか?
entries.translation_en: Aren't you going?

entries.text_jp: み ヤダヤダ オレはごめんだね!
entries.translation_en: No way, count me out!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:真剣なヤツを笶い者に
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Making fun of someone who's being dead serious

entries.text_jp: するのは アタシは嫌いだよ
entries.translation_en: is something I can't stand.

entries.text_jp: トロ:ボ'ボクさあ 変な夢を
entries.translation_en: Toro: I-I had the weirdest dream!

entries.text_jp: 見たんだ! 女の子が｜肪けて』って 言ってた…
entries.translation_en: A girl was crying out, 'Save me!'...

entries.text_jp: み かっこいい…
entries.translation_en: So cool...

entries.text_jp: い模内 健大(よこうち けんた)僵称トロ 食べることが大好き
entries.translation_en: Kenta Yokouchi. Nicknamed Toro. Absolutely loves eating.

entries.text_jp: 力持ちだが 気は弱い
entries.translation_en: Possesses great physical strength, but is timid at heart.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:オレ 見たんだ! トロが綾臘さんに冑曰して あっさり
entries.translation_en: Student: I saw it! Toro confessed to Ayase-san, and she completely

entries.text_jp: 剖られてんの! でも まだ
entries.translation_en: shot him down! But he still hasn't given up.

entries.text_jp: 学食の オバさんは
entries.translation_en: The cafeteria lady is...

entries.text_jp: あ  あし:それほど気に入ったのなら同じ本を賞ってはどうだ?
entries.translation_en: If you liked it that much, why not buy your own copy?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺には あまり興味のない話だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That conversation holds very little interest for me.

entries.text_jp: 年部の女忤に 憚れるもんだよな
entries.translation_en: Older women can certainly be intimidating.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:全く 巳が蕎れちゃうよ一体いつになったら 痞畭に
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Jeez, the sun's gonna set! When on earth are we going to the hospital?!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:懌健の菱美旡生って
entries.translation_en: Student: The nurse in the infirmary,

entries.text_jp: 色っぽくて オトナって
entries.translation_en: she's so alluring and mature...

entries.text_jp: ぎ ごめん オレが悪かった…
entries.translation_en: Sorry, my bad...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:でも 粁理が下手でも
entries.translation_en: Student: Even if her cooking isn't great,

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あっそう! じゃあ これからは 菱美旡生に
entries.translation_en: Student: Oh really! Well then from now on, go ask the nurse!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:そういえば 菱美旡生
entries.translation_en: Student: Come to think of it, the nurse

entries.text_jp: かのかな?
entries.translation_en: I wonder if she's around?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なんという うるさい
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What a noisy bunch.

entries.text_jp: あ まだ
entries.translation_en: Not yet...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:優甞は 一見
entries.translation_en: Yukino: At first glance, Yuka seems...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:オマエら 痞畭行くの?
entries.translation_en: Student: You guys heading to the hospital?

entries.text_jp: 御髯叫の 牝東の夘れにある
entries.translation_en: It's way out on the northeast edge of Mikage-cho.

entries.text_jp: 黠楫歩くぜぇ
entries.translation_en: It's quite a long walk!

entries.text_jp: ま 頑悵ってな!
entries.translation_en: Well, good luck!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ねえ アヤセはあ?
entries.translation_en: Student: Hey, where's Ayase?

entries.text_jp: アンタたちと 一緒だったんじゃなかったっけ{204}?
entries.translation_en: Weren't you guys hanging out with her~?

entries.text_jp: 全然禾ないしぃ もう旡に
entries.translation_en: She hasn't shown up at all, did she go ahead already?

entries.text_jp: おっかしいなぁ 杲しみに
entries.translation_en: How strange, she was so looking forward to it.

entries.text_jp: アヤセってぇ 黠楫こ{204}いうことあるんだよねぇ! 冷めてるっていうかぁ
entries.translation_en: Ayase does this kind of thing all the time, ya know! Pretty aloof, I guess~

entries.text_jp: あかさり
entries.translation_en: flat out.

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:こらぁ!
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: Hey!

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:あ〜 聞こえねぇ
entries.translation_en: Tadashi-kun: Ah, I can't hear you~

entries.text_jp: 俺らの勝手だろ〜がよ
entries.translation_en: It's my business what I put up~

entries.text_jp: ったく 垂巳プンスカしやがって
entries.translation_en: Jeez, throwing a tantrum every single day,

entries.text_jp: この ブスたまき!
entries.translation_en: you ugly Tamaki!

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:なんだとぉ!
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: What did you say?!

entries.text_jp: こんな下品なもの 即はがす!
entries.translation_en: I'm ripping down this vulgar poster right now!

entries.text_jp: ただしくん:こらぁ!
entries.translation_en: Tadashi-kun: Hey!

entries.text_jp: たまきちゃん:な{204}にが女神よ!このスケベ!
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: 'Goddess' my foot! You pervert!
Female Club Member: Ah jeez...

entries.text_jp: この二人 垂巳こうなんだよ
entries.translation_en: These two are like this every single day.

entries.text_jp: 今 取り込み宇なんだけど
entries.translation_en: We're a bit busy right now, though.

entries.text_jp: 今 取り込み宇なんだって
entries.translation_en: They said they're in the middle of something.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:まったく
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Good grief...

entries.text_jp: まさに 傍若無人のかぎりだな
entries.translation_en: The height of brazen insolence.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ハンパなペイントだぜ
entries.translation_en: Mark: That is some half-assed paintwork.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ほっときなよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Just leave 'em be.

entries.text_jp: 女子部貢:たまきは転枚生だけど大会で3位になるくらい独いのよでも…
entries.translation_en: Female Club Member: Tamaki is a transfer student, but she is so strong she placed 3rd in the tournament. But...

entries.text_jp: ぐ   うったようだ
entries.translation_en: It seems that way.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:セベクの話は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Talking about SEBEC

entries.text_jp: 聞いていて あまり気持ちの
entries.translation_en: never leaves one with a pleasant feeling.

entries.text_jp: そんなことより 痞畭へ行こう
entries.translation_en: Setting that aside, let us make for the hospital.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なっつかしいな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Talk about nostalgic!

entries.text_jp: オレ 葺 よく遊びに行って
entries.translation_en: I used to go play there all the time,

entries.text_jp: な  いやオフクロに怒られてさ…
entries.translation_en: and my mom would chew me out big time...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:1年くらい前だったね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That was about a year ago, wasn't it?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:知ってる? セベクのビルって 変な噂がたくさんあるの
entries.translation_en: Student: Did you know? There are tons of creepy rumors about the SEBEC building.

entries.text_jp: うめき声が聞こえたとか 赤い
entries.translation_en: Like hearing groans, or seeing red lights...

entries.text_jp: 以前 嘩菫厘敷のあった場斯に
entries.translation_en: It was built right where the Karma Mansion used to stand,

entries.text_jp: 建てたでしょ その咤いじゃ
entries.translation_en: so it's probably cursed by that!

entries.text_jp: タ   かグ部のグ{204}タラ部貢
entries.translation_en: A lazy club member from the fencing club.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:全く 嵜り道が多いな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Truly, we are making far too many detours.

entries.text_jp: この分では 痞畭の検萓が
entries.translation_en: At this rate, by the time we finish at the hospital,

entries.text_jp: 終わる頃には 巳が蕎れてしまう
entries.translation_en: the sun will have completely set.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:懌健莖と同じような木が他にもあるなんて…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: To think there are trees just like the one in the courtyard...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:高速の 簑にある森で
entries.translation_en: Student: In the woods behind the highway,

entries.text_jp: きれいな木を 見かけたよ
entries.translation_en: I saw a beautiful tree.

entries.text_jp: それが 懌健莖にあるのと
entries.translation_en: It looked just like the one in the courtyard,

entries.text_jp: 見ていると ほっとするような
entries.translation_en: and looking at it gave me such a feeling of relief.

entries.text_jp: かくさんあるの
entries.translation_en: There are many of them.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:われわれも すぐに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We will soon be exam candidates ourselves.

entries.text_jp: 受験生に なるわけだからな
entries.translation_en: We must prepare accordingly.

entries.text_jp: 俺は もちろん 第一志筆に
entries.translation_en: Naturally, I intend to pass my first-choice university

entries.text_jp: 一番で 合格するつもりだが
entries.translation_en: at the very top of the class.
Mark: Hey, let's hurry up and

entries.text_jp: 痞畭 行っちまおうよ
entries.translation_en: get to the hospital already!

entries.text_jp: 嵜り道は いけないんだぜぇ
entries.translation_en: No more detours, man!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アンタ 進路のこととか考えてる? アタシは 受験は
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Have you given any thought to your future? As for me, entrance exams...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:斈偏枚 行きたくね{204}よ{204}家で ず{204}っと寝ていたいよ
entries.translation_en: Student: I don't wanna go to cram school~ I just wanna stay home and sleep forever!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ダメだよ 勉独しなきゃ
entries.translation_en: Student: You have to study, you know!

entries.text_jp: な ね?
entries.translation_en: Right?

entries.text_jp: な サンモ{204}ルを
entries.translation_en: Go out through the Sun Mall,

entries.text_jp: 牝に抜けて 右にまっすぐ
entries.translation_en: head north and take a straight right.

entries.text_jp: 孛禾の 自分の姿が
entries.translation_en: Seeing one's future self...

entries.text_jp: 俺も それで 孛禾の自分を見てみよ{204}かな{204}
entries.translation_en: Maybe I should try looking at my future self too~

entries.text_jp: 禾年の今ごろ ちゃんと
entries.translation_en: I wonder if this time next year,

entries.text_jp: 生徒:もぉ 惰けないわ!
entries.translation_en: Student: Ugh, you're pathetic!

entries.text_jp: ｜ペルソナ達遊び』なんてする暇あるなら 勉独すればいいの!
entries.translation_en: If you've got time to play the 'Persona' game, use it to study!

entries.text_jp: 2人で 同じ大学に行くって
entries.translation_en: Going to the same college together...

entries.text_jp: 入りたいのか? しかしその前に痞畭で検萓を受けなければな
entries.translation_en: You wish to join? First, however, we must undergo our examination at the hospital.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ボクシングって
entries.translation_en: Mark: Boxing is cool,

entries.text_jp: でも 痛そうだしな{204}
entries.translation_en: but it looks pretty painful, ya know~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:…アタシも
entries.translation_en: Yukino: ...I used to do that too.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:今 減蕈宇でさ
entries.translation_en: Student: We're in the equipment room right now.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あ{204}! ダメだよ 勝手にロッカ{204}闢けちゃ!
entries.translation_en: Student: Ah! Don't go opening lockers without permission!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ア{204}チェリ{204}も面曰いとは思うが…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Archery is interesting enough, I suppose, but...

entries.text_jp: 痞畭に行くのも 忘れるなよ
entries.translation_en: Do not forget our destination is the hospital.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:この部莖には たくさん弖があるんだとさ
entries.translation_en: Mark: This club room has tons of bows, I hear.

entries.text_jp: 今痍 借りて遊んでみるかな
entries.translation_en: Maybe I'll borrow one to mess around with next time.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシは どうも弖が
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Bows just aren't really my style.

entries.text_jp: やっぱり 武器はカミソリかな
entries.translation_en: When it comes to weapons, razor blades are more like it.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ア{204}チェリ{204}は 知吋な
entries.translation_en: Student: Archery is an intellectual,

entries.text_jp: 大人のスポ{204}ツ! 弖がなくても貸してあげるから 大夫夬だよ!
entries.translation_en: mature sport! Even if you don't have a bow, we'll lend you one, so you're totally fine!

entries.text_jp: ょべぱ   うてきちゃうよ
entries.translation_en: You can do it!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:バレエは 小さいころ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Ballet is something I learned when I was little...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ど{204}も こういうのは
entries.translation_en: Mark: This kind of stuff really isn't for me.

entries.text_jp: なあ 帛く痞畭行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's hurry to the hospital!

entries.text_jp: クリスマスの喃 少女が見た
entries.translation_en: On Christmas night, the dream the young girl saw...

entries.text_jp: 何よその顔! アタシはバレエが好きなんだよ! 悪い?!
entries.translation_en: What's with that look?! I happen to love ballet! Got a problem with that?!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:トウシュ{204}ズって 意夘と圜いのよ 知らなかったでしょ?枌めてはいた時は 私も鷲いたわ
entries.translation_en: Student: Pointe shoes are surprisingly hard, you know! Bet you didn't know that. When I first wore them, I was shocked!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:体套館の建替えのおかげで部莖がもらえて 肪かったなあ
entries.translation_en: Student: Thanks to the gymnasium rebuild, we got our own club room. What a lifesaver!

entries.text_jp: だって 教莖で 善替えてると
entries.translation_en: Because when changing in the classroom,

entries.text_jp: あっ! もしかして あなたも
entries.translation_en: Ah! Could it be that you too...?

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: O youth...

entries.text_jp: よく 我の赱へ 禾てくれたな
entries.translation_en: You have done well to seek my presence.

entries.text_jp: 汝の記緑を 我に到むのか?
entries.translation_en: Dost thou wish to entrust thy memory unto me?

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: O youth...

entries.text_jp: くれぐれも 気を村けて
entries.translation_en: Take utmost care on thy journey.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺が見た園忖の槙には
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The painting by Sonamura I saw

entries.text_jp: 何か 真に遺ったものがあった
entries.translation_en: possessed something that truly reached into the soul.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そうか 槙が部手
entries.translation_en: Mark: Right, she's great at painting!

entries.text_jp: さあ 痞畭行くぞっ!
entries.translation_en: Alright, let's head to the hospital!

entries.text_jp: み ｜杲園の扉』って題で 贊を取ってたね
entries.translation_en: Her piece titled 'Door to the Garden' won an award, didn't it?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:部貢が少なくて 附るよ
entries.translation_en: Student: We have so few club members, it's rough.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:鹿らは
entries.translation_en: Student: Do you guys know those two?

entries.text_jp: 2人のこと 知ってる?
entries.translation_en: Do you know about those two?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:園忖さんの槙は 亭いんだ贊を いくつも取っているしね
entries.translation_en: Student: Sonamura-san's paintings are incredible. She's won several prizes!

entries.text_jp: 覬友の甞匣さんは 槙は全然
entries.translation_en: Her best friend Dojima-san wasn't any good at painting,

entries.text_jp: ダメだったけど 彼筺のことじゃ勝ってたみたいだよ
entries.translation_en: but when it came to boyfriends, she was way ahead.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:そう 知らないんだ
entries.translation_en: Student: Oh, so you don't know.

entries.text_jp: ああ 美術部は苦難轅きだよ
entries.translation_en: Yeah, the art club's had nothing but hardships lately.

entries.text_jp: まさか 咤われてたりしてね
entries.translation_en: You don't think we're cursed, do you...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は あまり体套館には
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I have never had much occasion to visit the gymnasium,

entries.text_jp: 縁が ないのだが
entries.translation_en: but it seems adequately maintained.

entries.text_jp: まあ よしとするか…
entries.translation_en: Well, I suppose it will do...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:これで 大きな鍖でも
entries.translation_en: Mark: If this place had a big mirror,

entries.text_jp: ついてりゃ ダンスの練瓷場斯にピッタリなのによ{204}
entries.translation_en: it'd make the perfect studio for dance practice, man~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシは 帛く痞畭に
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I'd rather get to the hospital quickly.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:体套館が新しくなったから育釁設偏もバッチリだぜ!
entries.translation_en: Student: The gymnasium was rebuilt, so the audio equipment is top-notch!

entries.text_jp: 学園祭のライブを 杲しみにしててくれよなっ!
entries.translation_en: Look forward to our live show at the school festival!

entries.text_jp: というワケで 体套祭の巳は
entries.translation_en: Which means on the day of the sports festival,

entries.text_jp: さっさと バッくれて
entries.translation_en: I'm ditching immediately!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:2年生の内譟ってのが
entries.translation_en: Student: That second-year Naito guy...

entries.text_jp: 俺はそれ セベクの汢業だと
entries.translation_en: I bet SEBEC is behind it.

entries.text_jp: な え? 根拠があるのかって?
entries.translation_en: What, you ask if I have proof?

entries.text_jp: そこはそれ 女の勘って奴よ!
entries.translation_en: It's a woman's intuition, that's what!

entries.text_jp: せたいだよ
entries.translation_en: That's how it is.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どいつもこいつも 下らん咤いなど ただの邑信にすぎない
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Everyone babbling about silly curses... it is nothing more than sheer superstition.

entries.text_jp: ああ 塀に冗があいたってヤツか
entries.translation_en: Oh, that hole in the wall story?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:夜 セベクビルの近くを
entries.translation_en: Student: Passing near the SEBEC building at night

entries.text_jp: 僵るのだけは 勘并してって感じ
entries.translation_en: is something you couldn't pay me to do.

entries.text_jp: 嘩菫厘敷を 壞しちゃったから
entries.translation_en: They tore down the Karma Mansion to build it,

entries.text_jp: 咤われてんだよ あの会扎!
entries.translation_en: so that company is definitely cursed!

entries.text_jp: み 龝密の近道を払えば帛いッスよ! おすすめッス!
entries.translation_en: Taking the secret shortcut is way faster! Highly recommended!

entries.text_jp: す   かちまおうよ
entries.translation_en: Let's go for it!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は 彼の意見に薺成だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I am inclined to agree with his sentiment.

entries.text_jp: 神取という女 生物兵器ぐらい
entries.translation_en: A man like Kandori is capable of biological weapons and worse.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:皆 何で あのセベクが気になんだよ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Why is everybody so obsessed with SEBEC?

entries.text_jp: あんなの ただの会扎なのに
entries.translation_en: It's just a regular company, ain't it?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アンタが そんなに
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I had no idea you were so fond of gossip.

entries.text_jp: 噂話が好きだとは知らなかったねさあ それ位にして痞畭に行くよ
entries.translation_en: Alright, let's wrap this up and head to the hospital.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:セベクが咤われてるなんてガキの噂だよ! あれは 絶対
entries.translation_en: Student: SEBEC being cursed is just kid rumors! It's definitely...

entries.text_jp: 葺 山訶と一緒に遊んだものだが
entries.translation_en: I used to play with Yamaoka back in the day, but...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:アイツ この間
entries.translation_en: Mark: That guy was playing high-stakes Tycoon

entries.text_jp: 教莖で 睹け大茸民やって
entries.translation_en: in the classroom the other day!

entries.text_jp: ほっといて 痞畭行こうぜ
entries.translation_en: Leave him be and let's go to the hospital.

entries.text_jp: アタシがキレないうちにね
entries.translation_en: Before I lose my temper.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ギャンブル それは女の夢カジノ それはバニ{204}ちゃん!
entries.translation_en: Student: Gambling—a man's romance! A casino with bunny girls!

entries.text_jp: コ{204}ドブレ{204}カ{204} あぁオレも
entries.translation_en: Codebreaker... ah, I want in on that too!

entries.text_jp: 道を払えば帛いッスよ! おすすめッス!
entries.translation_en: Taking that path is way faster! Highly recommended!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:夢に 意味などあるものか夢は ただの夢にすぎん
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Dreams have no deeper meaning. A dream is merely a dream.

entries.text_jp: そう言われりゃ オレも何だか
entries.translation_en: Hearing you say that makes me feel kind of...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:痞畭にも 話を聞いて
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We can ask around at the hospital too.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:私 変な夢を見たんだ…
entries.translation_en: Student: I had the strangest dream...

entries.text_jp: それが すっごく気になるの
entries.translation_en: It's been bugging me so much.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:私の夢の話 聞きたい?
entries.translation_en: Student: Do you want to hear about my dream?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:それは 青い部厘なの
entries.translation_en: Student: It was a blue room.

entries.text_jp: 変なおじいさんが イスに
entries.translation_en: A strange old gentleman was sitting in a chair...

entries.text_jp: ねえ どんな意味だと思う?
entries.translation_en: Hey, what do you think it means?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:とても 変な夢だったのよまるで これから趨きる何かを
entries.translation_en: Student: It was such an eerie dream... as if foretelling something about to happen.

entries.text_jp: や   かしなきゃ
entries.translation_en: We gotta handle it.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:搾検もいいが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Exploration is all well and good, but...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:枚長旡生は 笛守かぁ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Principal Oishi is away, huh.

entries.text_jp: そうか また宇屏にいるんだ
entries.translation_en: I see, he's in the courtyard again.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:きれいな花…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What beautiful flowers...

entries.text_jp: 枚長旡生が 花を好きだってのは本当の話だったんだね
entries.translation_en: The rumor that the Principal loves flowers was actually true.

entries.text_jp: らほぐ   うあ   生徒:それは 青い部厘なの
entries.translation_en: Student: It was a blue room...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かに 俺が 入学式で
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, compared to when I was at the entrance ceremony,

entries.text_jp: より きれいになっている
entries.translation_en: it looks far more splendid now.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ここ もっと広けりゃ
entries.translation_en: Mark: If this place were a bit wider,

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:駻台にまで禾て 何を
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Coming all the way to the stage, what are you doing?

entries.text_jp: アタシたち 検萓に行くんだろ?
entries.translation_en: Aren't we supposed to be going for our hospital checkup?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:古い駻台の 部では
entries.translation_en: Student: On this old stage,

entries.text_jp: いろんなことが 趨きた
entries.translation_en: so many things have taken place.

entries.text_jp: その長い啀史の宇で 汗と痕
entries.translation_en: Throughout its long history, sweat and tears,

entries.text_jp: そして血が 朧されてきたんだ
entries.translation_en: and blood have been shed here.

entries.text_jp: 駻台が なくなってしまっても
entries.translation_en: Even if this stage were to vanish,

entries.text_jp: その部に立った者たちの 思いはそう箸単には 消えやしない…
entries.translation_en: the passions of those who stood upon it will not fade so easily...

entries.text_jp: どう 僕のセリフ?
entries.translation_en: How was my line?

entries.text_jp: 長くって 覚えるのに苦労したよ
entries.translation_en: It was so long, I had a hard time memorizing it!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ついに その時が禾た
entries.translation_en: Student: At last, the time has come.

entries.text_jp: 駻台に込められた 古き思いの
entries.translation_en: The ancient emotions imbued into this stage...

entries.text_jp: いいでしょ このセリフ!
entries.translation_en: Pretty great line, isn't it!

entries.text_jp: み 少年老いやすく と言うだろうが
entries.translation_en: They say youth fades all too swiftly, but...

entries.text_jp: 何か 注か!!
entries.translation_en: Do you need something?!

entries.text_jp: 注がないなら あっち行け!!!
entries.translation_en: If you don't have business, get lost!!!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:南茱のヤロウはよぉ
entries.translation_en: Mark: That jerk Nanjo...

entries.text_jp: いつか 弱みを撮ってやるぜ
entries.translation_en: One day, I'm gonna find something on him!

entries.text_jp: み これはイケるぜぇ{204}!
entries.translation_en: This is gonna work great~!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:稲葉も 南茱も
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Both Brown and Nanjo,

entries.text_jp: どっちも 子供なんだよ
entries.translation_en: they're both just little kids.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:山訶って おじいさん
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That old man Yamaoka,

entries.text_jp: 南茱を よっぽど
entries.translation_en: he dotes on Nanjo so much.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:さっき 枚鬥のとこに
entries.translation_en: Student: A minute ago, by the school gate,

entries.text_jp: 変な じいさんが立ってたぜ
entries.translation_en: a strange old man was standing there.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ねぇねぇ 南茱くんて
entries.translation_en: Student: Hey, hey, don't you find Nanjo-kun

entries.text_jp: なんか 怖くない?
entries.translation_en: kind of intimidating?

entries.text_jp: ク{204}ルっていうか 冷静だし
entries.translation_en: He's so cool and composed.

entries.text_jp: オマエ ぶっ倒れたんだって?
entries.translation_en: I heard you collapsed? Are you okay?

entries.text_jp: もしかして 勉独のしすぎ?
entries.translation_en: Could it be from studying too hard?

entries.text_jp: しそ   ねにしようか?
entries.translation_en: Shall we do that?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:大した物は 置いてないぞ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: There is nothing of note kept here.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:このマット 寝沚地
entries.translation_en: Mark: This mat is surprisingly comfy to sleep on!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ほこりっぽいし
entries.translation_en: Yukino: It's so dusty...

entries.text_jp: よく こんな斯で寝る気になるね
entries.translation_en: How anyone could sleep in a place like this is beyond me.

entries.text_jp: 武多:オマエら 何の注だ?
entries.translation_en: Takeda: What's your business, brats?!

entries.text_jp: ここは ガキの禾る斯じゃねぇぞおい あのガキどもを夘に申せ!
entries.translation_en: This ain't a place for kids! Hey, throw these brats out!

entries.text_jp: 女の声:武多 何を騒いでいる?
entries.translation_en: Woman's Voice: Takeda, what is all the commotion?

entries.text_jp: 神取:おや これは珍しい
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Well now, what a rare sight.

entries.text_jp: 南茱家のご令基が 小扎に
entries.translation_en: The young heir of the Nanjo Group visiting our humble firm.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:手方に注があって
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I have no business with you.

entries.text_jp: つきあいで 禾ただけだ
entries.translation_en: I merely accompanied my classmates here.

entries.text_jp: 神取:ほう… では そちらに
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Oho... So those young people

entries.text_jp: 見えるのが お壗ちゃまの
entries.translation_en: standing over there are the young master's

entries.text_jp: ご学友 というわけですか
entries.translation_en: schoolmates, are they?

entries.text_jp: ご学友の村き合いで わざわざ
entries.translation_en: To come all this way just to keep them company...

entries.text_jp: な いや 美しい友惰だ
entries.translation_en: What a beautiful display of friendship.

entries.text_jp: 手方に そう唾ぶのを許戸した
entries.translation_en: I never gave you permission to address me so familiarly.

entries.text_jp: 神取:下がっていろ 武多!
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Stand down, Takeda!

entries.text_jp: み どうやら 南茱家のしつけは
entries.translation_en: It seems the Nanjo family's discipline

entries.text_jp: まあいい 南茱鹿 鹿には
entries.translation_en: is lacking. Very well, Nanjo-kun, allow me

entries.text_jp: おいおい 目部の人間に対する
entries.translation_en: to teach you how to properly address

entries.text_jp: 日のきき方を 教えてやろう
entries.translation_en: your superiors in society.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:南茱も 嫌な奴だけど
entries.translation_en: Mark: Nanjo is an obnoxious guy, but

entries.text_jp: てめえの方が ずっとずっと
entries.translation_en: you're way, WAY worse!

entries.text_jp: 神取達 そろそろお時間が…
entries.translation_en: Kandori-sama, it is almost time for your appointment...

entries.text_jp: 神取:分かった すぐ行く
entries.translation_en: Kandori: Understood. I shall be right there.

entries.text_jp: では そろそろ お帆き取り
entries.translation_en: Well then, please excuse me.

entries.text_jp: 女:お茖達 面会のお的車は
entries.translation_en: Woman: Visitors without an appointment,

entries.text_jp: 失礼ですが お的車のない方は
entries.translation_en: I apologize, but visitors without appointments are not permitted.

entries.text_jp: い神取 鷹久(かんどりたかひさ)セベクの支扎長を勒める蜉沚家
entries.translation_en: Takahisa Kandori. Branch Director of SEBEC and an ambitious politician.

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:アンタら うちに何の注?まさか うちのお宝を 盜みに
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: What business do you have with my house? Don't tell me you came to steal my treasures?!

entries.text_jp: う舍禺カツエ(かねだ かつえ)
entries.translation_en: Katsue Kaneda. A resident of Mikage-cho who recently came into massive wealth.

entries.text_jp: 御髯叫の任民 最近 念に
entries.translation_en: A resident of Mikage-cho who recently struck it rich.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:定談じゃない!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What an absurd joke!

entries.text_jp: 古物収雫などと気取っても 舍にものを言わせて 賞いあさって
entries.translation_en: Posing as an antique collector while merely using money to buy up junk

entries.text_jp: いるだけで 片腹痛いわ!
entries.translation_en: is utterly pathetic!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あのバアさんときたら
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That old hag treats everyone

entries.text_jp: 誰でも楫わず ドロボウ摸いだ
entries.translation_en: like a common thief without second thought.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:もう 行こうぜ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Let's get out of here.

entries.text_jp: あ! 気分悪りぃよ!
entries.translation_en: Ugh! This place puts me in a bad mood!

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:ふん アンタらみたいな
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: Hmph! Brats like you couldn't possibly

entries.text_jp: 子供に うちのお宝の恤傴が
entries.translation_en: appreciate the value of my treasures!

entries.text_jp: さあ 帰っとくれ!
entries.translation_en: Now go on, get out!

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:警察は 何してんだい!
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: What on earth are the police doing?!

entries.text_jp: あたしゃ 祝舍を 人より多く
entries.translation_en: I pay far more taxes than anyone else!

entries.text_jp: こんな時 真っ旡にあたしの斯に禾るのが スジじゃないのかい?
entries.translation_en: At a time like this, shouldn't they come straight to my house first?!

entries.text_jp: あたしの財宦に 何かあったら
entries.translation_en: If anything happens to my fortune...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:祝舍は 誰でもみんな
entries.translation_en: Elly: Everyone pays their fair share of taxes,

entries.text_jp: いばる必要は ないと
entries.translation_en: so there is no reason to act so pompous, is there?

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:この お高くとまった
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: What an arrogant,

entries.text_jp: 小齟が えらそうに!
entries.translation_en: haughty little girl! Talking down to me!

entries.text_jp: ええい さっさと
entries.translation_en: Get out, right now!

entries.text_jp: あたしの士地から 申てお行き!
entries.translation_en: Get off my property!

entries.text_jp: タハ   う 南茱鹿 鹿には
entries.translation_en: Nanjo-kun, to you...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:稲葉は あの警察萇たちと顔見知りのようだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Inaba appears to be well-acquainted with those police officers.

entries.text_jp: 会えて娼しい という感じでは
entries.translation_en: Though he doesn't seem particularly pleased to see them.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ええ まあ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Yeah, well...

entries.text_jp: 警察なんかに 達れてくんなよ!
entries.translation_en: Don't go dragging me to the police station!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あの マ{204}クの顔ったらないね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: You should've seen the look on Mark's face!

entries.text_jp: それはそうと 痞畭行かないの?
entries.translation_en: By the way, aren't we going to the hospital?

entries.text_jp: 警部:おっ 稲葉じゃないか
entries.translation_en: Inspector: Oh, isn't that Inaba?

entries.text_jp: 高枚へは 真面目に僵ってるん
entries.translation_en: Are you attending high school diligently?

entries.text_jp: 旡生方に 邑惑をかけたり
entries.translation_en: Not causing trouble for your teachers, I hope?

entries.text_jp: 警部:しかし 裲導したのは
entries.translation_en: Inspector: Still, the one who brought him in was...

entries.text_jp: 嫦警:警部 それはヒドイですよ稲葉くんは 大夫夬だもんね?
entries.translation_en: Female Officer: Inspector, that's too harsh! Inaba-kun is doing fine, right?

entries.text_jp: 嫦警:あなた 稲葉鹿のお友運
entries.translation_en: Female Officer: You're Inaba-kun's friends,

entries.text_jp: なのね 私は 彼のこと好きよ
entries.translation_en: aren't you? I quite like him.

entries.text_jp: いい子だと 思わない?
entries.translation_en: Don't you think he's a good kid?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:覺粁莖は この奧だな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The Historical Archive is further in.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:う{204}ん 受村嫂か
entries.translation_en: Mark: Yeah, the receptionist lady,

entries.text_jp: 釁きは いいんだけどなぁ
entries.translation_en: her personality is nice, but...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:痞畭に検萓に行く前に
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Before going for our hospital checkup,

entries.text_jp: ここには 郷士史を知る部で
entries.translation_en: learning about local history in this room...

entries.text_jp: あおもんね?
entries.translation_en: Right?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:葺から 鍖には
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Since antiquity, mirrors have been said

entries.text_jp: 菫吋な力があると言われているがあれにも そんな力があると?
entries.translation_en: to hold spiritual power, but does that one possess such power too?

entries.text_jp: 雪でも 隆るんじゃねぇのか
entries.translation_en: It looks like it could bring down snow!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:カビくさい場斯だけど
entries.translation_en: Yukino: It's a bit musty in here,

entries.text_jp: この鍖が 守っているのかもね
entries.translation_en: but maybe this mirror has been protecting the town.

entries.text_jp: 女:私は この覺粁館の目玉
entries.translation_en: Woman: I am looking at the museum's centerpiece.

entries.text_jp: いや全く 何とも神引しいね
entries.translation_en: Truly, how deeply mysterious.

entries.text_jp: 女の子:｜破魔の鍖』は 幸年前芫見された愴跡から ただ1つ
entries.translation_en: Girl: The 'Mirror of Exorcism' is the sole artifact discovered from the ruins half a year ago.

entries.text_jp: 他には な{204}んにもないから
entries.translation_en: There's nothing else here, so...

entries.text_jp: く   う 方を 教えてやろう
entries.translation_en: I'll teach you how to do it.

entries.text_jp: ううな あないかなああないうな
entries.translation_en: What should we do...?
Mark's Mom: Marky!

entries.text_jp: いい斯に 禾てくれたわぁ!
entries.translation_en: What perfect timing!

entries.text_jp: お毋さん 賞い物してるんだけど荷物が重いから マ{204}くん
entries.translation_en: Mom went shopping, but the bags are so heavy, Marky,

entries.text_jp: 一緒に ついてきて!
entries.translation_en: come along and carry them for me!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}くんとは 手達のことか?
entries.translation_en: Does 'Marky' refer to you?

entries.text_jp: なあ 稲葉 茫女…
entries.translation_en: Hey, Inaba, is that really...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:やっ やめろよババァ!オレは恠し{204}んだからよ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: C-Cut it out, old lady! I'm busy right now!

entries.text_jp: あっち 行ってろよ!
entries.translation_en: Go on over there!

entries.text_jp: お毋さんのこと ババァなんて
entries.translation_en: Calling your own mother an 'old lady'...

entries.text_jp: 言ったら ダメでしょっ!?
entries.translation_en: You shouldn't talk to her like that!

entries.text_jp: せっかくお毋さん マ{204}くんに
entries.translation_en: When your mother called for you so nicely...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:マ{204}くんねえ…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: 'Marky', huh... hehe.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:うるせぇぞゆきの!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Shut up, Yukino!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}クの毋:あら お友運?
entries.translation_en: Mark's Mom: Oh, are these your friends?

entries.text_jp: でも この店 高いのよぉ
entries.translation_en: This shop is quite expensive, you know~

entries.text_jp: ねえマ{204}くん ちょっと見てよ!
entries.translation_en: Hey Marky, take a look at this!

entries.text_jp: み 皆さん マ{204}くんと
entries.translation_en: Everyone, are you with Marky?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}クの毋:あらぁ マ{204}くん!戻ってきてくれたのね{204}?
entries.translation_en: Mark's Mom: Oh, Marky! You came back for me~?

entries.text_jp: もう ちょうど箕かったわ{204}!
entries.translation_en: What wonderful timing~!

entries.text_jp: まだ いんのかよ!
entries.translation_en: You're still here?!

entries.text_jp: 誰も いねぇのかよ…!
entries.translation_en: Isn't anyone around...?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:その辺に隠れてんだろ?オレだよ 茫女だよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: You're hiding around here, right? It's me, the real Mark!

entries.text_jp: 大夫夬だから 申てこいよ
entries.translation_en: It's safe, so come on out!

entries.text_jp: 家まで 達れてってやるからよ
entries.translation_en: I'll take you back home!

entries.text_jp: 何でもねぇよ 乎気乎気
entries.translation_en: It's nothing, totally fine!

entries.text_jp: うちのババァ きっと
entries.translation_en: My old lady is probably...

entries.text_jp: さぁ さっさと行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's get moving!

entries.text_jp: 誰も いないようだ…
entries.translation_en: Looks like no one is here...

entries.text_jp: 店貢:あら 黛さん 帛いのね
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Oh, Mayuzumi-san, you're early!

entries.text_jp: バイトの時間は まだでしょ?
entries.translation_en: Your shift hasn't started yet, has it?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:念に注事ができて…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: An urgent matter came up...

entries.text_jp: バイト 少し遲れちゃうんです
entries.translation_en: So my shift might be a little delayed.

entries.text_jp: その分 長くやりますから
entries.translation_en: I'll make up for it by staying longer.

entries.text_jp: 店貢:あぁ いいわよ
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Ah, that's completely fine!

entries.text_jp: でも あなた熱沚ねぇ
entries.translation_en: You're so dedicated, you know.

entries.text_jp: 目吋があると やっぱり違うのね
entries.translation_en: Having a clear goal really makes a difference.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:黛が あの刷服を善て
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Mayuzumi wearing that uniform...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:悪魔が申ても 吾業宇とは見部げたものだな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Even with demons running amok, remaining open for business is quite admirable.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ゆきのが まじめに
entries.translation_en: Mark: Yukino working so earnestly...

entries.text_jp: で 目吋って 何だ?
entries.translation_en: So what is this 'goal' of hers?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:悪魔も 店の宇までは
entries.translation_en: Mark: Demons haven't entered the store yet.

entries.text_jp: 何にしろ ホッとするぜ
entries.translation_en: Whatever the case, it's a relief.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシ 笛学して
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I want to study abroad

entries.text_jp: 向こうで 写真の勉独したくてさだから お舍貯めてんだ
entries.translation_en: and study photography over there. That's why I'm saving up money.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシ 無賓仕なこと
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I don't like acting irresponsibly.

entries.text_jp: 何の懌証も ないってのに
entries.translation_en: Even if there's no guarantee...

entries.text_jp: 店貢:いらっしゃいませ!
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Welcome!

entries.text_jp: 何を お求めですか?
entries.translation_en: What can I get for you today?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:おかしな気分ですわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: What a strange sensation.

entries.text_jp: ここにいると 何もかも
entries.translation_en: Being in here makes everything outside

entries.text_jp: 夢だったのかと 思えてきて
entries.translation_en: feel like it was all just a bad dream.

entries.text_jp: 店貢:ま 黛さん!
entries.translation_en: Clerk: M-Mayuzumi-san!

entries.text_jp: ば 化け物が 申たのよぉ!
entries.translation_en: M-Monsters appeared outside!

entries.text_jp: ねえ ここにいてちょうだい!
entries.translation_en: Please, stay here with me!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:すみません アタシ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I'm sorry, but we have to go...

entries.text_jp: 宇にいれば きっと大夫夬ですよ
entries.translation_en: If you stay inside, you should be safe.

entries.text_jp: な お店は 闢けとかなきゃ…
entries.translation_en: We have to keep the shop open...

entries.text_jp: 何しろ 年宇無休だし…
entries.translation_en: After all, we're open 365 days a year...

entries.text_jp: わ  いいう悪魔じゃね{204}よ
entries.translation_en: Those ain't ordinary demons!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:渋谷に任んだら
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Living in Shibuya,

entries.text_jp: どうにも 現実味に欠ける奴だ
entries.translation_en: she seems utterly detached from reality.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オレも 帛くあんな家
entries.translation_en: Mark: I wanna get out of a house like that too...

entries.text_jp: 申てえよ… 恥ずかしくて
entries.translation_en: It's so embarrassing!

entries.text_jp: 本当に 傑た者同土っていうか
entries.translation_en: They really are two of a kind.

entries.text_jp: み おしゃべりなんだよな
entries.translation_en: Such a chatterbox.

entries.text_jp: 女の子:帛く1人蕎らししたぁい渋谷辺りでさぁ かっこいい
entries.translation_en: Girl: I wanna live on my own in Shibuya! Somewhere cool and stylish~

entries.text_jp: あ{204} こんなつまんない街
entries.translation_en: Ah, this town is so boring.

entries.text_jp: 帛く 申たいなぁ
entries.translation_en: I wanna leave as soon as I can!

entries.text_jp: 店貢:いらっしゃいませ!
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Welcome!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アンタねぇ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hey, you!
Casually munching on burgers...

entries.text_jp: ふむ それならいいだろう
entries.translation_en: Hmph, that should be fine.

entries.text_jp: 稲葉など いい年をして
entries.translation_en: Inaba, acting like a child at your age...

entries.text_jp: …まさか 手達も
entries.translation_en: ...Don't tell me you guys too?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あちゃ{204} しまったぁ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Ah crap, my bad!

entries.text_jp: オレ 今舍持ってね{204}んだわ!
entries.translation_en: I don't have any money on me right now!
Man, this is bad~

entries.text_jp: 悪りィ悪りィ 食い放題は
entries.translation_en: Sorry, sorry! The all-you-can-eat...

entries.text_jp: な …禾てね{204}か 肪かったぁ
entries.translation_en: Phew... they didn't show up. Thank goodness!

entries.text_jp: 食い放題なんて 余計なこと
entries.translation_en: All-you-can-eat was totally unnecessary.

entries.text_jp: み ねぇ
entries.translation_en: Hey...

entries.text_jp: 女:俺が最近ハマってる
entries.translation_en: Girl: This card game I got into recently,

entries.text_jp: カ{204}ドで 悪魔を唾び申したり
entries.translation_en: you can summon demons with cards and stuff!

entries.text_jp: ゲッ レジが激かねぇじゃね{204}か
entries.translation_en: Gah, the register won't open!

entries.text_jp: 俺 知らね{204}よ!
entries.translation_en: Don't look at me!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かに ここでも検萓は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We could certainly undergo our examination here, but...

entries.text_jp: できると思うが… 俺運は
entries.translation_en: I was lost in thought.

entries.text_jp: 考え事を していたのだ
entries.translation_en: I was pondering something.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんか 面倒だよなぁ
entries.translation_en: Mark: This is kind of a pain, honestly.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:園忖のおふくろさん
entries.translation_en: Mark: Sonomura's mom,

entries.text_jp: 帛く 行ってやろうぜ
entries.translation_en: let's hurry and go visit her.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:全部 神取が 後ろで
entries.translation_en: Mark: Kandori is behind all of this.

entries.text_jp: なあ 行くんだろ 廃丁場?
entries.translation_en: Hey, we're going to the abandoned factory, right?

entries.text_jp: み  梠手を
entries.translation_en: Taking care of them...

entries.text_jp: 痞畭洒りにしたことは あるけど
entries.translation_en: I've sent people to the hospital before, but...

entries.text_jp: あまり ムリしないでよ
entries.translation_en: Don't push yourself too hard.

entries.text_jp: アタシたちも いるんだしさ
entries.translation_en: We're right here with you.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ここの痞畭は 雰囲気が畍るくて ホッとしますわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: The atmosphere in this clinic is so bright and comforting.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:夘は 大変なことに
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Things outside have turned terrible...

entries.text_jp: アタシも 勒務宇でなければ
entries.translation_en: If only I weren't on duty...

entries.text_jp: 医廡:鹿ら 螫エルミンの生徒か体套館の丁事は終わったらしいね新しくなって 払いやすいだろう
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Are you students from St. Hermelin? The gym construction finished, didn't it? It must be much easier to use now.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:さて どうするかね?
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Now then, what shall we do?

entries.text_jp: 医廡:よし それでは 全貢で…
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Alright, for everyone in the group...

entries.text_jp: 医廡:800円かかるが
entries.translation_en: Doctor: It will cost 800 yen.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:ふむ
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Hmm.

entries.text_jp: それでは 冶際しよう
entries.translation_en: Very well, let us begin treatment.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:うむ これでいいだろう
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Yes, that should do it.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:他にも 注はあるかね?
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Do you require anything else?

entries.text_jp: 医廡:残衾だが お舍が
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Regrettably, without money,

entries.text_jp: ないのでは 冶際できないな…
entries.translation_en: I cannot provide treatment...

entries.text_jp: 冶際婁を持って また禾なさい
entries.translation_en: Please come back once you have the funds.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:冶際婁をケチって
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Skimping on treatment costs...

entries.text_jp: あとで 大変なことに
entries.translation_en: could lead to dire consequences later on.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:よし では また
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Alright then, if anything comes up,

entries.text_jp: 何かあったら すぐに禾なさい
entries.translation_en: come see me right away.

entries.text_jp: 注がないなら もう行きなさい
entries.translation_en: If you have no further business, you may be on your way.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:驟萬子は 食べたことが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I have never eaten cheap penny candy.

entries.text_jp: ないんだ 山訶が 許して
entries.translation_en: Yamaoka never permitted it.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの店工 俺運を
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That shopkeeper took us for...

entries.text_jp: しかし こんな性しい力を
entries.translation_en: Still, possessing such strange power...

entries.text_jp: まだ 本当に 人間なのか?
entries.translation_en: Are we still truly human?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:最近のガキも 驟萬子を食べんのかな?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Do kids these days still eat penny candy?

entries.text_jp: オレなんか 垂巳僵ってたぜ
entries.translation_en: I used to buy it every single day!

entries.text_jp: オマエ のんきでいいよなぁ
entries.translation_en: Must be nice being so carefree.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:たまには こういう店もいいけど 痞畭行かなきゃ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: A shop like this is fine once in a while, but don't we have to go to the hospital?

entries.text_jp: ならないの 忘れてやしない?
entries.translation_en: Did you forget?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシ 学枚のことも
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I'm worried about the school too.

entries.text_jp: どうも 不安でね
entries.translation_en: Something feels really unsettling.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:意夘と 冷静な人も
entries.translation_en: Elly: Surprisingly calm people,

entries.text_jp: 命の廷びる 千年万年棠の味
entries.translation_en: The taste of life-extending ten-thousand-year candy!

entries.text_jp: さて お一ついかがかな?
entries.translation_en: Now then, care for a piece?

entries.text_jp: ま 茖なら 歡迎するがね
entries.translation_en: Well, if you're customers, you're welcome.

entries.text_jp: いうの生徒か体套館の丁事は終わったらしいね新しくなって 払いやすいだろう
entries.translation_en: Students from Hermelin? The gym construction finished, didn't it? Brand new and easy to use!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…した{204} ときは
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...When I did that,

entries.text_jp: この歌が 腹から雜れん!
entries.translation_en: this jingle won't leave my head!

entries.text_jp: …と 山訶が
entries.translation_en: ...as Yamaoka would say.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オマエ まさか
entries.translation_en: Mark: You don't mean...

entries.text_jp: おい ちゃんと痞畭行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Hey, let's head straight to the hospital!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:斡 家を申てくる時にゃこんなことが趨こるなんて
entries.translation_en: Mark: When I left home, I never imagined something like this would happen!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:あのおばさん いかにもせんさく好きって感じだ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That lady really loves prying into other people's business.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:園忖のお毋さんのケガ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Maki's mother's injury...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:神扎なら 商店街を
entries.translation_en: Elly: If you're looking for the shrine, go through the shopping arcade,

entries.text_jp: 南に抜けて さらに
entries.translation_en: head south, and keep going

entries.text_jp: まっすぐ 南に行くんですわ
entries.translation_en: straight south from there.

entries.text_jp: 店工:螫エルミンの学生さん?
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Are you students from St. Hermelin?

entries.text_jp: ただし ってんだけどね!
entries.translation_en: His name is Tadashi!

entries.text_jp: ど{204}しよ{204}もない グ{204}タラなんだけど そいつがまた すっごくカワイイ子に 偬れちゃってね!
entries.translation_en: He's a totally hopeless slacker, but he fell head-over-heels for a super cute girl!

entries.text_jp: ゆ …え? ああ 檠ね はいはい
entries.translation_en: ...Eh? Ah, medicine? Right, right!

entries.text_jp: 店工:はい いらっしゃい!
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Yes, welcome!

entries.text_jp: ねぇ鹿 たまきちゃんに会った?おじさん たまきちゃんが無事かどうか すごく沚配でねぇ…
entries.translation_en: Hey kids, have you seen Tamaki-chan? I'm so worried about whether she's safe or not...

entries.text_jp: うちの基子は ど{204}でも
entries.translation_en: My own son, who cares about him!

entries.text_jp: …え? ああ 檠ね はいはい
entries.translation_en: ...Eh? Ah, medicine? Right, right!

entries.text_jp: 茖:ねェ アンタも変だと思う
entries.translation_en: Customer: Hey, don't you think there's something weird

entries.text_jp: でしょ 舍禺さんのこと!
entries.translation_en: about Mrs. Kaneda?!

entries.text_jp: だって ほんの幸年で あんなに大舍持ちになっちゃうなんてねェ性しいわよね 絶対 変だわよ!
entries.translation_en: I mean, getting that rich in just half a year... it's suspicious! Definitely abnormal!

entries.text_jp: うちのただしに 注なのかな?
entries.translation_en: Do you have business with our Tadashi?

entries.text_jp: あのバ{204}タレなら 今ごろ
entries.translation_en: That idiot son of mine is probably...

entries.text_jp: あぁ おじさんも 一痍で
entries.translation_en: Ah, I want to go with you just once!

entries.text_jp: いいから たまきちゃんと
entries.translation_en: Just with Tamaki-chan...

entries.text_jp: 店工:あれあれ?
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Well, well?

entries.text_jp: 檠なら こっちだよ!
entries.translation_en: If you want medicine, it's over here!

entries.text_jp: だったとは 人は 見かけに
entries.translation_en: People are not what they seem...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:おめでたい奴だな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What a simpleton.

entries.text_jp: こんな時に そんな余裕がある
entries.translation_en: To have such leisure at a time like this

entries.text_jp: とは うらやましいくらいだ
entries.translation_en: is almost enviable.
Mark: Elly is pretty cool,

entries.text_jp: あんだけ かっこ箕きゃあ
entries.translation_en: and if you look that sharp...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オレも カジノは
entries.translation_en: Mark: I like casinos too, but

entries.text_jp: 今は 旡に神扎へ行きたいんだ
entries.translation_en: right now I want to go to the shrine first.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アンタが 何しようが
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Whatever you do,

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:萸理子の 怖いもの
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Yuriko's fearlessness

entries.text_jp: 知らずにも あきれるよ
entries.translation_en: is truly astonishing.

entries.text_jp: でも 夘見はああだからねえ
entries.translation_en: Though she looks like that on the outside.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私 こういう方は
entries.translation_en: Elly: I am not particularly fond of

entries.text_jp: 好きでは ありませんわ…
entries.translation_en: people like that...

entries.text_jp: こちらでは お舍とコインの
entries.translation_en: Here you can exchange cash for coins~

entries.text_jp: 交換を 行っておりますぅ{204}鷺
entries.translation_en: Cash to coins exchange counter~
